content:
Hey all! Some of you may have seen the official announcement already. The next CT will be held in Patras, Greece! I think I can speak for everybody here in Greece when I say that we are all very excited to host you and the conference! And I wanted to start an unofficial thread in case anyone want to discuss CT2027-related stuff. You can find some initial information on the official website:
https://categorytheory2027.github.io/
and I would be happy to aid you further however I can. Feel free to drop a message here or directly to me!

Some important dates in case you've missed them:
Abstract submission deadline - 28 Feb 2027
Notification of acceptance - 12 April 2027
Early bird registration deadline - 15 April 2027
Registration deadline - 01 May 2027

Invited speakers:
Alexander Campbell
Denis Charles Cisinski
Hadrian Heine
Dorette Pronk
Giacomo Tendas
Tim Van der Linden
